name: Open Book
text: After bidding, look at your partner's hand.
archetypes: Kingmaker, Nil Guard, Exact Contractor; splash Swap Meet
decision: How to play around your partner's cards: which suits to lead to them, which winners to hold back for an exact count, and how to cover a nil partner.
opponent: Opponents see that you looked; only you learn the cards.
aiNote: Lead your partner's strongest suit; on a partner nil, play your highest card in suits where they hold high cards.
rationale: Full knowledge of one hand after bidding helps the team play every trick without changing either bid, so it is a strong common for partnership decks and gives the opponents nothing.
deviation: Redesigned from every player revealing two random cards, which helped the opponents as much as you.
